# Woodsmith

> > Woodsmith is a comprehensive woodworking magazine and resource featuring detailed project plans, techniques, and tool reviews for woodworkers of all skill levels.

Published since 1981, Woodsmith provides in-depth woodworking content including furniture projects, joinery techniques (mortise-tenon, dovetails), tool reviews (table saws, routers, planers), and material guides (premium plywood, veneer). The magazine features both traditional craftsman-style builds and modern designs, with extensive tips on workshop setup and finishing techniques.

## Key Topics

- Mortise-tenon joinery
- Table saw techniques
- Router accessories and techniques
- Premium plywood (Baltic birch, AraucoPly, ApplePly)
- Dovetail joinery
- Veneer and veneering
- Craftsman-style furniture
- Workshop jigs and fixtures
- Finishing techniques (General Finishes, Benjamin Moore)
- Band saw and blade selection
- Shaker furniture design
- Vacuum press applications
- Tool reviews (Rockler, Woodcraft)
- Dust collection and shop air quality
- Lathe turning and accessories

## Getting Started

- [Woodsmith Homepage](https://www.woodsmith.com): Homepage for woodworking tips, techniques, projects for all skill levels

## Magazine Issues (2007-2013)

- [Magazine Issue 169 (Feb 2007)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/169): Feb 2007 issue: parallel-jaw clamps, crosscut techniques, drop-front storage

## Magazine Issues (1994-2004)

- [Magazine Issue 159](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/159): Table saw upgrades, Timberwolf band saw blades, veneer, router baseplates
- [Magazine Issue 154 (Aug 2004)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/154): Aug 2004 issue: veneer buying, dovetail routing, glass cutting, media cabinet

- [Magazine Issue 91 (Feb 1994)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/91): Feb 1994 issue: tool cabinet, Shaker bench, mortise joints, coffee table

## Classic Magazine Issues (1981-1984)

- [Magazine Issue 33 (May 1984)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/33): May 1984 issue: modular wall unit, desk clock, sandpaper, tongue-and-groove
- [Magazine Issue 16 (Jul 1981)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/16): Jul 1981 issue: TV tray tables, blanket chest, mortise-tenon, coin sorter
- [Magazine Issue 15 (May 1981)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/15): May 1981 issue: oak furniture, table and chair building, mortise-tenon joints
- [Magazine Issue 14 (Mar 1981)](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/issue/14): Mar 1981 issue: Pembroke table, Butler's tray table, turned canister project

## Newsletters and Tips

- [Woodworking Dust Control Made Easy (Jan 28, 2026)](https://www.woodsmith.com/newsletter/2026/01/28): Shop air cleaner for dust control, portable workbench with bench dogs
- [Build a Casual Coffee Table (Jan 14, 2026)](https://www.woodsmith.com/newsletter/2026/01/14): Coffee table project with shop jigs, thickness planer, drum sander tips
- [Zero Clearance Insert Plate Upgrade (Mar 6, 2025)](https://www.woodsmith.com/newsletter/2025/03/06): Zero clearance insert upgrade for table saw with threaded inserts
- [Submit Your Tip](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine/tip): Submit woodworking tips and techniques for magazine publication
